native_no_venue_reconciliation: OrderDenied is a publisher-guaranteed local denial. The callback retires a never-venue reservation first. A missing reservation or a no-broker/no-fill not_sent record settles reconciliation locally and enables the existing durable paced retry.
attempted_reconciliation: An uncertain attempted request remains blocked until a healthy complete snapshot reconciles its client_order_id and confirms a terminal outcome. Missing attempted IDs still fail closed.
diagnostics: Only the leading canonical native code is retained; unknown diagnostics become NATIVE_DENIAL_UNKNOWN.
integrity_policy: integrity_lost is permanent for the damaged observation session and released only by healthy fresh recovery.
